```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
listings_clean <- readRDS("listings_clean.rds")
glimpse(listings_clean)
```

```{r}
count(listings_clean, room_type)
```

```{r}
listings_no_shared <- listings_clean |>
  filter(room_type != "Shared room") |>
  droplevels()

count(listings_no_shared, room_type)
```

```{r}
# quick check
levels(listings_subset$room_type)
```


```{r}
ggplot(listings_no_shared, aes(room_type, price)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Room type", y = "Price (£)", caption = "Source: InsideAirbnb.com")
```

```{r}
price_density <- ggplot(
  listings_no_shared,
  aes(x = price, fill = room_type)
) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5, colour = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Entire home/apt" = "pink",
      "Private room" = "skyblue"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 1000, by = 250)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of price of Airbnb listings in Edinburgh",
    subtitle = "Prices restricted to range £25 to £1,000",
    x = "Price (£)",
    y = "Probability density",
    fill = "Room type",
    caption = "Source: InsideAirbnb.com"
  ) +
  theme_gray()

print(price_density)
```

```{r}
listings_no_shared |>
  group_by(room_type) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_price = mean(price),
    sd_price = sd(price),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

```{r}
library(knitr)

listings_subset |>
  group_by(room_type) |>
  summarise(
    count=n(),
    mean_price=round(mean(price),2),
    sd_price= round(sd(price),2),
    variance=round(var(price),2)
  ) |> 
  
  kable()
```

```{r}
t.test(price ~ room_type, data = listings_subset)
```

```{r}
leveneTest(price ~ room_type)
```



















```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(listings_clean, aes(room_type, price)) +
  geom_boxplot() + labs(x = "Room type", y = "Price (£)") + theme_minimal()
print(p1)
```

```{r}
print(p1 + scale_y_log10())
```

```{r}
print(ggplot(listings_clean, aes(bedrooms)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, boundary = -0.5))
```

```{r}
p2 <- listings_clean |> filter(!is.na(bedrooms)) |>
  ggplot(aes(factor(bedrooms))) + geom_bar() +
  labs(x = "Bedrooms", y = "Listings") + theme_minimal()
print(p2)
```

```{r}
print(count(listings_clean, bedrooms))
```

```{r}
p3 <- listings_clean |> drop_na(review_scores_rating) |>
  ggplot(aes(review_scores_rating, price)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "blue") +
  labs(x = "Average review score", y = "Price (£)") + theme_minimal()
print(p3)
```

```{r}
p4 <- ggplot(listings_clean, aes(fct_rev(fct_infreq(property_type)))) +
  geom_bar() + coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Property type", y = "Listings") + theme_minimal()
print(p4)
```

```{r}
top10_neighb <- listings_clean |> count(neighbourhood_cleansed, name = "Count") |>
  arrange(desc(Count), neighbourhood_cleansed) |> slice_head(n = 10)
print(top10_neighb)
```

```{r}
p6 <- ggplot(top10_neighb, aes(fct_reorder(neighbourhood_cleansed, Count), Count)) +
  geom_col(fill = "skyblue") + coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Listings", title = "Top 10 neighbourhoods") + theme_minimal()
print(p6)
```
